units.source_text: 不久之后，母亲写信给自己，信里说妹妹照子已经完成了纳聘仪式，俊吉在山手郊外建了新房，等待迎娶照子。

en.t: Before long, her mother wrote to her saying that her younger sister Teruko had already completed the betrothal ceremony, and that Shunkichi had built a new house in the suburbs of Yamate and was waiting to marry Teruko.

units.source_text: 信子马上给母亲和妹妹照子回了长长的祝福回信，

en.t: Nobuko immediately wrote a long letter of congratulations in reply to her mother and her younger sister Teruko,

units.source_text: 当她写到“因为除了自己家里无人照料，尽管自己很想去，但很遗憾的确无法亲临婚礼现场……”的时候，

en.t: but when she came to the part where she wrote, "Because there is no one but me to look after the house, although I very much want to go, I regret that I truly cannot attend the wedding in person ...",

units.source_text: 不知何故，她数次写不下去。

en.t: for some reason, several times she found herself unable to continue writing.

units.source_text: 写不下去的时候，她必定会远眺松林，看着初冬的天空下，郁郁苍苍的美景。

en.t: Whenever she could not go on writing, she would always gaze into the distance at the pine grove, looking at the deep green beauty beneath the early winter sky.
